2609.30214.title: Underwater C3-JEPA: An Object-Centric Cross-View World Model for ROV Salvage
2609.30214.paper_summary: We present Underwater C$^{3}$-JEPA (cross-view, control-conditioned, context-extended), an object-centric multi-view predictive world model for near-field heavy-load underwater ROV salvage. Without contact sensors, it predicts in latent space how the task-object state evolves through contact interaction and under the hydrodynamic lag of the vehicle, from synchronized multi-view RGB observations and vehicle control signals. C$^{3}$-JEPA encodes multi-camera observations into task-object and context tokens, fuses cross-camera evidence through held-out-view attention, and directly predicts future states conditioned on control. Weak binding anchors the target and gripper at low annotation cost, while SIGReg sharpens the geometric representation. Experiments show that the learned representation transfers substantially more task-relevant information to downstream probes than a reconstruction-free latent baseline, while keeping the predictor lightweight. The resulting predictive interface supports model-predictive-control (MPC) candidate evaluation and imagined-rollout behavior-agent training. Validation on real underwater video shows the same architecture recovering a withheld camera's object state and staying ahead of persistence, so the recipe transfers beyond simulation.
2609.30214.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了水下 C$^{3}$-JEPA（跨視角、控制條件、上下文擴展），這是一個面向物體的多視角預測世界模型，用於近場重載水下 ROV 拯救。它在沒有接觸傳感器的情況下，預測任務物體狀態如何通過接觸互動和在車輛的水動力延遲下演變，這是基於同步的多視角 RGB 觀察和車輛控制信號。C$^{3}$-JEPA 將多攝像頭觀察編碼為任務物體和上下文標記，通過保留視角注意力融合跨攝像頭證據，並直接根據控制預測未來狀態。弱綁定以低標註成本將目標和夾具固定在一起，而 SIGReg 則加強幾何表示。實驗表明，學習到的表示比無重建潛在基線傳遞了更多與任務相關的信息到下游探測器，同時保持預測器輕量化。所得到的預測介面支持模型預測控制（MPC）候選評估和想像展開行為代理訓練。在真實水下視頻上的驗證顯示，相同的架構能夠恢復被保留攝像頭的物體狀態並保持在持久性之前，因此這一方法可以超越模擬。
